name: com.hollowmere.mechanism.pressureplate
description: Sample mechanism package (W-MECH-01): a pressure plate. Pure rules (Rules/, engine-free, dotnet-testable): a press is one actor stepping on or off; the plate is pressed while its weight reaches the threshold; refusals plate.not-loaded, plate.overloaded, plate.unknown. Kernel half: one plugin with the plate.pressed and plate.weight slots, the plate.press route and the PlatePressed, PlateReleased and PlateWeightChanged events, its own generated catalog composed with the world catalog through CatalogSet.Combine. Runtime: PressurePlateMechanism.Extend/Attach, PressurePlateWorld, the PressurePlateSmoke world, the pressureplate.definition authorable and a headless-safe binder. Editor: the mechanism.pressurePlate.add tool.
